bibl.title: Tragic quotations in Favorinus' De exilio: literary texture, politics, and consolation.
bibl.seg: Francesco Lupi, Tragic quotations in Favorinus' De exilio: literary texture, politics, and consolation.
bibl.note: Analyses the presence of references to and quotations from Attic tragedy in the Περὶ φυγῆς of second-century CE rhetor Favorinus of Arelate. By focusing on select fifth-century tragedies referred to in Favorinus' consolation On exile, argues that the rhetor deliberately chose to include quotations from dramas concerned with the clash of identities between Greeks and barbarians (such as Euripides' Telephus and Erechtheus and Sophocles' Tereus).
